item.title: HB114 — Motor vehicles; federal regulations regarding safe operation of commercial motor vehicle and carriers; update reference date (Enacted)
item.description: HB114 amends O.C.G.A. § 40-1-8 to update the reference date for incorporating federal safety regulations governing motor carriers, commercial motor vehicles, drivers, and hazardous-materials transport, and revises a definition within that section. The effect is to align Georgia's adopted federal safety standards with a more current version of the federal regulations. The bill text does not specify the new reference date or which definition is revised. Why it matters: Updated federal safety standards now apply as the negligence-per-se benchmark in commercial motor vehicle and trucking cases. AI-drafted summary. Verify against the enrolled bill. https://legiscan.com/GA/bill/HB114/2025

item.title: HB94 — Insurance; medically necessary expenses for standard fertility preservation services when a medically necessary treatment for cancer, sickle cell disease, or lupus may directly or indirectly cause an impairment of fertility; require coverage (Enacted)
item.description: Amends Chapter 24 of Title 33 to require certain insurance policies to cover medically necessary expenses for standard fertility preservation services when a medically necessary treatment for cancer, sickle cell disease, or lupus may directly or indirectly impair fertility. The Act provides definitions, exclusions, permissible cost-sharing, and authorizes implementing rules and regulations. The prior rule did not mandate this specific coverage; the text does not spell out the full scope of affected policies here. Why it matters: Expands mandated insurance coverage, potentially generating coverage disputes over fertility-preservation benefits tied to cancer, sickle cell, or lupus treatment. AI-drafted summary. Verify against the enrolled bill. https://legiscan.com/GA/bill/HB94/2025
